description: The China Land Surveying and Planning Institute publishes rural-road density for Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei in 2020. It extracts centre lines from rural-road vector data and calculates their density within one-kilometre grid cells. The result is intended to describe farming access and rural development conditions. ScienceDB hosts the product under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, allowing free non-commercial reuse with attribution and share-alike conditions. The inspected metadata does not identify the storage format. Grid density cannot determine whether particular settlements connect to each other, and it contains no traffic speeds or capacities. It can still supply rural accessibility proxies and spatial covariates for land-use or agricultural-logistics simulations. The product complements data-openstreetmap when a separate connected road network is needed.
